name: Tems
notes: "The point where Afrobeats and trap-soul merged commercially", and the model's single loudest parameter is the register: "a dark, heavy, low contralto placed in the male tenor register with a distinctive husky timbre — the register and grain are the parameters — sung at low note-density with long held notes, and narrow doubles rather than wide stacks". So the melody register sits below middle C for most of its span, `densityPerBar` is low, and the counter is narrow rather than the wide stack the rest of the section uses. She shares the Afrobeats grid with Amaarae but is not the same model: her low end is "a short, plucked, rhythmically-active sub that follows the 3+3+2 kick rather than sustaining — the opposite of a long-decay 808", so the 808 is staccato with far fewer slides, and "percussion carries more information than the kit does" with a woodblock or rimshot marking the 3+3+2 accent. Harmony is "minor-mode modal vamps of 2 bars, m9/m11 colour, with the harmony held static across whole sections; occasional gospel cadence on the ballads" — the vamp plus one cadential family. ⚠ `confidence` is **low**, mirroring medium-low: "tempo, drum and low-end detail are idiom inference". ⚠ All drum, 808 and density numbers are **INFERRED**. ⚠ `session.bpm.mode` is **INFERRED**: the number is not stated in the entry, and it is an authored centre of gravity inside the band the entry does state. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **`chords.harmonicRhythm` re-weighted (2026-08-17, harmony variety floor).** The entry's harmony line is "minor-mode modal vamps of 2 bars, m9/m11 colour, with the harmony held static across whole sections; occasional gospel cadence on the ballads", and the engine's `vamp` value is *one* chord held for the whole clip (`generators::chords`: "One chord for the whole pattern") — so weighting `vamp` at the top rendered a **one**-chord bed the research nowhere describes. The chord motion the entry states is now carried by `1_per_bar` (the pair over a 2-bar cell) and `2_bars_per_chord` (the pair over a 4-bar cell), with `vamp` kept as the minority for the held reading. A 2-bar vamp is `1_per_bar`, and the "occasional gospel cadence" is what the four-chord family needs more than one slot to state at all. ⚠ The split between those two rates is **INFERRED** — the entry names the device, not its rate. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 924/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.18 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. Second, `countermelody.densityRatio` became a range, [0.28, 0.45], rather than a flat 0.28. That parameter decides how many notes the part has at all, and at 0.28 it was two or three; a part that short has almost no shapes to be distinct in. The low end is kept because it is the thin reading the entry's texture implies, and it is now the bottom of a band rather than the only answer — so how much of the lead the pad answers varies take to take. ⚠ Every value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "sparse plucked guitar, filtered Rhodes, string pads and reverbed vocal chops. Melody is a dark, heavy, low contralto placed in the male tenor register with a distinctive husky timbre — the register and grain are the parameters — sung at low note-density with long held notes, and narrow doubles rather than wide stacks.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
